title: Multiple Meanings of Take
focus: Diferenciar os vários sentidos dos phrasal verbs com take pelo contexto
verifiableTask: Interpretar e usar phrasal verbs com take em contextos diferentes e explicar cada sentido

content.text: take off · take on · take up · take over · take after · take back · take in · take out · take down · take apart.
Ao final da aula você consegue:
reconhecer o sentido certo pelo contexto e usar os principais com naturalidade.
interpretar e usar phrasal verbs com take em contextos diferentes e explicar cada sentido.
Who do you take after in your family?
I can't take on more work.
The company is taking on new staff.
This sofa takes up too much space.
I'll take you up on that.
A big company took over our firm.
Can you take over while I'm at lunch?
I take it back — you were right.
It was a lot to take in.
They took in a stray cat.
Don't be taken in by the ad.
He took her out to dinner.
It was a LOT to TAKE IN.
I took up running, took on a new project and took Friday off.

explanations.general: Correct answer: it became successful quickly
Correct answer: she is similar to him

questions.questionText: “I take it back” (in a conversation) means…

explanations.general: Correct answer: I withdraw what I said

questions.questionText: This table takes ______ too much space. (ocupa — partícula)
“Take over” can mean take control of a company.

content.text: We're taking on ten new engineers.
The news was a lot to take in.
Don't be taken in by fake reviews.
My sister really ______ after our grandmother.
Can you ______ over the meeting? I have to leave.
Let me ______ down your email address.
→ took on / extra work → took off / two weeks in August → took apart / my old computer

explanations.general: Correct answer: separate it into pieces

questions.questionText: “Take out” can mean invite someone to a restaurant or event.
